reason: I do not have money for a monthly subscription, and my parents pay for everything, so even INR 99 a month means asking at home for something I cannot justify to them. The free ATS score and plan are useful, but I do not see what the Pro features do that my daily LeetCode and YouTube prep does not already cover.
objection: The Pro mentor gives hints, not answers, and I cannot tell if it is better than just reading editorials. The check that matters, running my code against hidden tests, is not available yet, so nothing here proves I am getting better.
would_change_my_mind: If the hidden-test judge were live and I could see it grade my code against real problems, I would ask my parents for the INR 499 six-month pass.
